exam_scheme.note: Under the Gujarat Subordinate Services Class-III (Combined Competitive Examination) Rules, 2023, selection comprises: Stage 1 Preliminary CBRT (100 marks, common to Group A & B), Stage 2 Mains Examination (Group A: 350-mark Descriptive Written Exam; Group B: 200-mark CBRT Objective Exam), followed by Stage 3 Document Verification. Negative marking in objective tests is 0.25 marks per incorrect response.

financial_package.note: Appointees in Gujarat Class-3 ministerial posts serve on fixed pay (Fix Pay System) during a 5-year probation. The monthly fixed pay was enhanced by Gujarat Finance Department GR in 2023 to ₹26,000 per month for Junior Clerks (Level 2) and ₹26,000–₹31,400 for Senior/Head Clerks (Level 4/5). Upon completion of probation, regular Pay Matrix Level 2 (₹19,950–₹63,200 with entry basic ₹19,950) or Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100 with entry basic ₹25,500) applies under the Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules Schedule Level 2
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 entry basic pay of ₹19,950 at 58% DA (₹11,571 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (10% to 24%: ₹1,995 to ₹4,788), Transport Allowance (₹900 + DA), net of NPS deduction (10% of Basic+DA = ₹3,152) and Professional Tax (₹200). For Group A Senior Clerks (Level 4, ₹25,500 basic), gross pay ranges from ₹45,500 to ₹50,500.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Gujarat Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on posting classification (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar/Surat or district offices)
Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) or health card under Gujarat State Employee Medical Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits upon regularization
Defined contributory pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS)
Annual increment of 3% upon regularization into the regular pay matrix
